name: Ogre Zombie

source.note: The 2024 Ogre Zombie (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block).

languages: Understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.summary: At 0 HP it makes a Con save (DC 5 + damage) to stay at 1 HP, unless hit by Radiant or a Critical Hit.
traits.text: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success it drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

summary: A lumbering, hard-to-put-down undead giant with a single heavy slam.
